newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech SME power pays no 1996 dividend - CTK.
newsitem.headline: Czech SME power pays no 1996 dividend - CTK.

text.p: Shareholders of the Czech energy distributor Severomoravska Energetika a.s. (SME), agreed to have no dividend paid on common stock out of 1996 net profit of 542.4 million crowns, the Czech CTK news agency reported on Tuesday.
SME paid a 30 crown gross dividend on 1995 profit.

CTK quoted company officials at the company's general meeting in the northeastern city of Ostrava as saying that shareholders' agreed to pay a 50 crown dividend per share on so-called employees' shares.
After provisioning for a reserve fund, the company has 1996 undistributed profit remaining of 491.54 million crowns, CTK said.
It said the 1997 business plan forecasts net profit of 365 million crowns on turnover of 13.66 billion crowns after turnover of 14.173 billion in 1996.
Company officials were not immediately available for further comment in Ostrava.
